events.name: Lost Umbrella
events.intro: A rain-soaked umbrella with a name tag sits on a bench. A woman is huddled under a shop awning across the road.

success.text: "Oh, thank you!" She presses a lucky coin into your hand. "Rain brings luck to those who share shelter."
You stay dry. Somewhere, a stranger sighs.

events.name: Shop Keeper's Delivery
events.intro: An old shop keeper can't lift his heavy bag. "Deliver it to the next town, and I'll pay by how far you carry it."

choices.label: Carry it (₽ grows with the stage)

success.text: You haul the bag a long way. He pays more than he promised.

choices.label: Send a Pokémon to carry it

success.text: Your strongest friend does the heavy lifting.
You wave and move on.

events.name: Stranded Cyclist
events.intro: A cyclist stares at a bent wheel. "Can you help? I'll lend you my bike for a bit."

failure.text: You make it worse. He thanks you anyway and walks.

success.text: You straighten the frame. He lends you his bike: the road ahead flies by.
He patches himself up and grins. The bike's yours for a stretch.
You move on.

events.name: Sick Trainer in the Rain
events.intro: A trainer shivers under a tree, feverish. "I just need to rest..."

success.text: The trainer recovers and falls in beside you for a few stages.
You wait out the rain together. They'll remember it.
You can't save everyone.

events.name: Blind Date Wingman
events.intro: Two nervous trainers sit at opposite tables, both glancing your way. "Please, help us talk!"

success.text: They laugh together! A grateful perk comes your way.

choices.label: Tell each what the other likes

success.text: A little fib, a big smile. They owe you.
Love finds a way.

events.name: Missing Cat Poster
events.intro: A poster: "Lost: Meowth, answers to Coins." A reward is promised.

failure.text: No sign of it. You tear off a tab of the poster for luck.

success.text: A Meowth is curled in a crate. You carry it home. The owner gives you a coin charm.

choices.label: Ask your Pokémon to sniff it out

success.text: Your lead tracks it down quickly. The owner is delighted.
You walk on.

events.name: Library Overdue Fine
events.intro: The library desk clerk taps a due date. "That book is a year overdue. ₽200, or you can read it back tonight."

success.text: "Thank you." She gives you a bookmark with a tip.

choices.label: Read the book aloud for the kids

success.text: Story hour is a hit. The fine is forgiven.

choices.label: Sneak out the side door (Speed check)

success.text: You slip away. Nobody noticed.

events.name: Neighbor's Garden Weeding
events.intro: A neighbor's garden is overrun with weeds. "Grass types would make quick work of this..."

success.text: Hard work, but the garden blooms. Your Grass types grow stronger.
You plant a berry bush.
The garden stays wild.

events.name: Charity Marathon Sponsor
events.intro: A runner shakes a donation tin. "Every ₽ goes to the Pokémon shelter!"

success.text: "Good Karma!" The crowd cheers. You feel lighter.
Your name goes on the banner. Your team feels sturdier too.
You jog beside them. They tip you a Potion.

events.name: Dog Walker (Growlithe)
events.intro: A woman begs: "Walk my Growlithe for a few stages? It needs the exercise. I'll pay when you come back!"

success.text: A Growlithe trots alongside you. It adores the road.
She finds someone else.

events.name: Growlithe's Owner Pays Up
events.intro: The woman waves from afar, Growlithe bounding to her. "Here's your payment, with a tip!"

success.text: She hands you cash and a treat.

events.name: Field Trip Chaperone
events.intro: A teacher asks you to guard a class of kids crossing the route. "Wild Pokémon sometimes appear."

failure.text: A scuffle! Everyone is safe, but your team takes bruises.

success.text: All the kids make it. Your team shares what it learned.
The kids are enchanted. They draw your team.
The teacher finds another volunteer.

events.name: Street Magician Volunteer
events.intro: "Need a volunteer!" The magician beckons you. The crowd claps.

success.text: A dove! A coin! An item from your sleeve?

failure.text: You blurt it out. The crowd boos him!

success.text: You catch the palm trick. The magician gives you a nod and a prize.
Someone else gets the card.

events.name: Midnight Lullaby
events.intro: A baby Pokémon cries in the night, and its parent is too tired to soothe it.

failure.text: Off-key. The baby wails louder, but the parent laughs.

success.text: It sleeps. The parent thanks you with a charm against drowsiness: a Clarity Blessing.
A soothing melody drifts. The baby sleeps like a stone.
The crying fades behind you.

events.name: Elder's Last Wish (1)
events.intro: A frail elder presses a letter into your hand. "Three things before I rest. First: deliver this to the old mill."

success.text: "Thank you." He tells you where to look. The mill is on your way.

effects.text: You took on an elder's last wish.

success.text: He sighs and turns away.

events.name: Elder's Last Wish (2)
events.intro: At the mill, an old friend reads the letter with tears in her eyes. "Tell him the star was real. Now, bring him a bowl of berries from the east grove."

success.text: You pick the sweetest. The trip leaves you tired, but the elder's friend gives you a keepsake.

events.name: Elder's Last Wish (3)
events.intro: The elder sits by the window, smiling. "One last thing: be kind to your Pokémon. They'll remember everything." He presses a worn charm into your hand.

success.text: He closes his eyes, content. His charm hums in your pocket.

effects.text: An elder's last wish was fulfilled.

success.text: You stay until dawn. Your team heals; his story stays with you.

effects.text: You sat with an elder until dawn.

events.name: Local Legend Autograph
events.intro: A famous trainer is signing autographs in the square. The line is long.

success.text: "Good luck out there, kid." The ball glows with their blessing.
The legend notices you and signs your team's sleeve.
You skip the line.

events.name: Flooded Basement Rescue
events.intro: Water pours into a cellar. Small Pokémon are crying from the dark.

choices.label: Wade in and save them (Strength check)

failure.text: The current is strong. You save most, and lose a few Potions.

success.text: You carry them out, one by one. One stays with you.
A slow job, but everyone's safe. You get paid.
Help arrives. You feel uneasy.

events.name: Berry Pie Contest Judge
events.intro: Four pies sit on the judge's table: Oran, Sitrus, Razz, and Pecha. Taste them all.

success.text: Humble but solid. It tastes like home.
Rich and juicy. Your team feels refreshed.
Sweet and spicy! A burst of energy.
Soft and fruity. A little cure for what ails you.

events.name: Lost Ring
events.intro: A ring glimmers in the grass. Four people nearby each claim it's theirs.

success.text: He's too eager. A liar.
The ring has her initials! You return it. She tips you well.
He knows the ring's engraving only after you read it aloud. A liar.
Too small for the ring. Not hers.

events.name: Mailman Shortcut
events.intro: A mailman is overwhelmed. "Can you take these letters down the road? I tip well!"

success.text: You deliver every one. Tips add up.
You peek. Guilt. Then you deliver it anyway.
Not your business.

events.name: Quiet Hermit
events.intro: A hermit lives in a hollow tree. He's hungry. "Bring food, and I'll tell you my story."

success.text: He eats and talks: a tale of a hundred battles. He shares a move tip.

effects.text: A hermit shared his story and a move tip.

success.text: Warm food, warm stories. He teaches your lead a trick.
You respect his solitude.

events.name: Broken Vending Poké Ball
events.intro: A vending machine blinks "ERROR" and spits out free Poké Balls in short bursts.

failure.text: It coughs once and goes dark.

success.text: It whirs! Free Poké Balls.
A bunch of balls tumble out!
You leave it be.

events.name: Taxi Driver's Fare
events.intro: A taxi driver is stuck with a flat. "Drive my car across the map and I'll make it worth your while!"

failure.text: You clip a fence, but you still get there.

success.text: Vroom! You zip ahead.

choices.label: Ask the driver to ride along

success.text: He keeps you honest. A smooth ride and a tip.
You walk.

events.name: Orchard Harvest Day
events.intro: It's harvest day at the orchard. Hands are needed.

success.text: Sticky and satisfying. You take home a basket.
You reach the best fruit.
Delicious. The farmer chuckles.

events.name: Soup Kitchen Volunteer
events.intro: A soup kitchen runs out of hands. A steaming pot waits.

success.text: The whole line eats. You eat too. Your team recovers a bit.
So many grateful faces.
You continue on your way.

events.name: Overgrown Graveyard Tidy
events.intro: A graveyard is overgrown. Whispers drift on the breeze.

success.text: You clear weeds and wipe moss. A pale shape nods in thanks.

effects.text: You tidied a graveyard; something watched.

success.text: A single flower is enough.
The whispers follow you.

events.name: The Ghost Remembers
events.intro: A pale light leads you off the path, away from danger. A ghost hovers in front of you and bows.

success.text: The ghost guides you to a hidden stash.

events.name: Zoo Keeper's Aid
events.intro: A little zoo of rescued Pokémon needs a hand. "Spend an afternoon with them?"

success.text: Every cage has a story. One rescue wants to come with you.
They crowd around you. You leave with affection and a snack.
"Every bit helps!"

events.name: Beach Cleanup
events.intro: The beach is littered. A few Trubbish rummage for snacks in the pile.

success.text: Together you sort the trash. You keep a bag of recyclables worth selling.

choices.label: Just pick up what you can

success.text: A small effort. A small reward.
You walk the shore.

events.name: Birthday Party Crash
events.intro: A kid's birthday party! "We need a battle show!" the parents plead.

failure.text: The show flops, but the kids still give you cake.

success.text: The kids love it. You get cake and a gift.

choices.label: Let the kids pet your Pokémon

success.text: Squeals of joy. Your team basks in it.
The party goes on.

events.name: Child's Drawing
events.intro: A child shows you a crayon map: a big X beside a tree. "My treasure! I'll share."

failure.text: Just a tin of marbles. The kid beams.

success.text: Under the tree: a buried tin box.

choices.label: Hang the drawing on a wall

success.text: The child glows with pride.
The child waves goodbye.

events.name: Pay It Forward
events.intro: At the counter, a stranger already paid for you. "Pass it on!" the note says.

success.text: Warm. You vow to do the same.
You top it off for the next person.

events.name: Passing It On
events.intro: A weary traveller counts coins at a stall. You step up and cover the tab.

success.text: "Pay it forward!" They smile; luck seems to find you.
A warm nod.

events.name: Kind Rival Visit
events.intro: Your rival is waiting by the road, not to battle, but to hand you a gift. "Good luck out there."

success.text: A small bundle of supplies.
You swap stories. Your bond grows.

effects.text: Your rival came by with a gift, not a fight.

events.name: Grandma's Recipe
events.intro: A grandmother shares a family stew recipe. "It heals everything, dear."

success.text: You jot it down. Your Pokémon will thank you at every campfire.
A cozy hour. The stew restores your team.

events.name: Marooned Sailor
events.intro: A sailor is stranded on a rock by the shore. "A boat! A boat!"

success.text: He's grateful. "Take this old chart. It leads somewhere... strange."

failure.text: The rope slips. He swims. He still tips you.

success.text: He's hauled in. A sea map is his thanks.
He shouts after you.

events.name: Barefoot Monk
events.intro: A monk limps at the foot of a hill. "I must reach the shrine. Can you carry me?"

success.text: A steep climb. At the shrine, he blesses you.
Your lead trudges up. He blesses it.
He thanks you quietly.

events.name: Rain Dance Ritual
events.intro: A village is parched. Elders dance and sing, but the sky stays clear. "Help us summon rain."

success.text: Thunder rolls. Rain! Crops are saved.
Your Pokémon's moves coax clouds to gather.
You move on.

events.name: Library Gift
events.intro: The librarian asks, "Share a Pokémon fact the shelves do not have yet?"

failure.text: She already has that one, but thanks you.

success.text: She writes it down and issues you a member's card.
A fine addition to the exhibit. She thanks you with a card.
You leave with new ideas.

events.name: Pokémon Hospice
events.intro: A quiet shelter cares for elderly Pokémon. A caretaker invites you to stay the night.

success.text: Old Pokémon tell stories. In the morning, the caretaker gives you a Soothe Bell.

effects.text: You spent a night at a Pokémon hospice.

success.text: "This will help many." They give you a small token.
A short visit, a long thought.

events.name: Soap Box Derby
events.intro: Kids are racing soap box carts down the hill. "Build one and race me!" a kid challenges.

failure.text: Wheels fall off, but you all laugh.

success.text: Your cart rolls fast! You win. The kid is thrilled.
He whoops with joy. "You're the best!"
A good race.

events.name: Trainer's Therapy
events.intro: A burnt-out trainer sits alone. "I do not know why I keep going."

success.text: You listen for an hour. They gift you a charm.

effects.text: You listened to a burnt-out trainer.

success.text: They smile for the first time. "Thanks."
Nope. They aren't ready.

events.name: The Last Cookie
events.intro: One last cookie sits on a plate. Your Pokémon eye it hopefully.

success.text: Everyone gets a crumb. Morale rises a little.
Delicious. Your Pokémon pout.

choices.label: Give it to the smallest Pokémon

success.text: It beams. The others pretend not to mind.
